title: Recommendation to accept a gift of four Booktrucks for the Woodland Hills Branch Library received from Woodland Hills Friends of the Library.
text:
[Board of Library Commissioners, Exhibit A]
Recommendation to accept a gift of four Booktrucks for the Woodland Hills Branch Library received from Woodland Hills Friends of the Library.
summary: The Board of Library Commissioners will consider accepting a gift of four booktrucks for the Woodland Hills Branch Library from the Woodland Hills Friends of the Library.
